scope: Four failed startup attempts, same compiled build, native/queued/queued/native. Separate instrumented fifth attempt excluded from ABBA means. Not gameplay FPS acceptance.
limitations: Only two attempts per mode, one GPU.
Clocks and browser/driver caches not controlled.
Matching final queue counts do not prove identical mesh identities.
Sibling CPU intervals only; nested CPU/async completion times must not be summed.
System samples infer windows and represent the whole card/process, not exclusively this game.

systemWindow.scope: Inferred interior of first seven completed stages; provider intervals, not frame-aligned samples. Arithmetic means, not time weighted.
systemWindow.derivation: outerStart=timeOrigin+lighting.atMs-lighting.elapsedMs; residual=lighting.elapsedMs-sum(all stage.elapsedMs); lo=outerStart+residual; hi=outerStart+sum(first seven stage.elapsedMs)
systemWindow.cpuSelection: provider.systemCpu.startedUtc-providerIntervalMs >= lo AND provider.systemCpu.endedUtc <= hi; finite rows[0].cpuPercent only. Whole collector utc/endedUtc/periodMs are not used.
systemWindow.gpuSelection: All NVIDIA rows with lo <= driverSampleUtc <= hi; last duplicate per driverSampleUtc, asserted one UUID; finite values only.
systemWindow.collectorScope: Logger values on the selected CPU-provider records; logger owns a different sampling boundary.
